audience: service and project businesses that run quotes, jobs and invoices in Zigaflow

useCases.title: Prepare for a client call
useCases.text: Find a client by name. Read the contacts, the open quotations and the recent jobs before you call.

useCases.title: Check the status of open quotations
useCases.text: List the quotations of one contact and open one to read its lines and totals.

useCases.title: Check stock before you promise a delivery
useCases.text: Read the stock level of a product with its prices and costs. Use it to answer a client without a trip to the warehouse.

useCases.title: Review purchase orders of a supplier
useCases.text: List the suppliers and their purchase orders. Open one order to see what you still wait for.

useCases.title: Review open tickets and tasks
useCases.text: List the support tickets and the tasks of the team. Open one ticket to read the full detail.
